title: How our office week runs today
summary: Bills arrive by email and are paid on the 20th after a text to the owner. Each one is saved in three places. Debtors are chased by phone when someone remembers.

detail.what: Suppliers email PDFs to the office inbox.
The office looks for the order in the owner's emails. The docket is usually in the ute.
rules: Within $20 ex GST of the order: pay
detail.source: Your answers to Q10 and Q11

detail.what: Within tolerance goes to the owner by text; anything else is queried.
Entered in Xero, paid in the bank app once a month.
goes_wrong: Paid supplier A's bill twice in July

detail.what: PDF saved to a monthly Drive folder, as well as Xero and the bank.
Painters text hours on Friday; Monday the office types them into Xero and checks overtime, the travel allowance and the apprentice's year rate; the owner approves Tuesday.
The owner rings homeowners over 30 days; builders get an email.
goes_wrong: Builder A holds 5% retention that nobody tracks
detail.source: Your answers to Q18 and Q19

first_skill.name: Your bill checker
first_skill.what: Drop in a bill; it checks it against the order and docket and only brings you the mismatches. You approve and pay.

parking.question: Supplier A's credit for the July duplicate
